name: Nexus Agent Core
description: Nexus Agent Core. Stage 1: the Task module (tools nexus_task_*, RPC nexus.task.*, open-Task prompt list). Stage 2: decisions, grants and executions with a fake provider (tools nexus_action_* / nexus_decision_request, RPC nexus.decision.* / nexus.execution.* / nexus.grant.*). Stage 3: a Claim / Evidence ledger with completion gating (tools nexus_claim_add / nexus_evidence_add / nexus_claim_verify, RPC nexus.claim.*). All off by default. Stage 0 runtime spikes remain behind spikesEnabled (see DESIGN.md section 13).

tasksEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 1 Task module: nexus_task_* tools (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.task.* gateway methods, the open-Task prompt list and the nexus.sqlite store. Off by default.

decisionsEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 2 decision module (needs tasksEnabled): nexus_action_prepare / nexus_action_authorize / nexus_decision_request / nexus_action_commit (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.decision.* / nexus.execution.* / nexus.grant.* gateway methods, and a FAKE provider. Off by default.

claimsEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 3 Claim / Evidence ledger (needs decisionsEnabled): nexus_claim_add / nexus_evidence_add / nexus_claim_verify (optional tools, allow them via tools.alsoAllow), nexus.claim.* gateway methods, completion gating for nexus_task_update(succeeded) and execution-result claims. Off by default.

evidenceBlobsEnabled.description: Enable Stage 3 evidence bytes (needs claimsEnabled): the operator upload RPC nexus.evidence.upload / .link and `blob` refs for nexus_evidence_add, stored through the plugin blob store with reservations, soft quotas and reclaim. Off by default.

evidenceTaskQuotaBytes.description: Soft evidence quota per Task in bytes (default 200 MB). Overflow fails closed and creates an R0 notice decision.

evidenceOwnerQuotaBytes.description: Soft evidence quota per owner in bytes, counted over physical objects (default 400 MB). The SDK's own ceiling is 512 MB for the whole plugin.

evidenceMaxUploadBytes.description: Largest single piece of evidence in bytes (default 16 MB; the SDK allows 100 MB). Uploads travel base64-encoded in one RPC frame, so keep it below the gateway payload limit.

evidenceWriterLeaseMs.description: Writer lease for an evidence write in flight. Expiry only allows reclaim to claim the object; it never proves the write stopped.

evidenceReservationTtlMs.description: How long an unsettled reservation counts against the quota before reclaim may claim it. Lower it only for testing.

evidenceDebugDelayAfterA2Ms.description: DEV ONLY: pause between the byte write and the final admission, to let a test kill the gateway inside that window.

fakeProviderIdempotent.description: Stage 2 fake provider: honour the provider idempotency key (retries are safe). Set false to exercise the 'no idempotency support, reconcile only' path.

fakeProviderMode.description: Stage 2 fake provider failure injection: reject = provider declines; drop_after_success = effect happens but the connection drops (execution becomes unknown); drop_before_send = nothing happens and the connection drops.

coreApprovalEnabled.description: Attach an optional core approval card to nexus_decision_request on user turns. The Nexus decision page (nexus.decision.*) is always the primary path.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the optional core approval card. Lower it (e.g. 120000) if the host rejects timeouts above 2 minutes.

ownerId.description: MVP owner id placeholder (DESIGN section 5). Not a security boundary. Defaults to "local".

spikesEnabled.description: Register the Stage 0 spike probes (gateway methods nexus.spike.*, tool nexus_spike_probe, probe service). Off by default so the plugin is inert.

spikeStopDelayMs.description: Spike 3 item 4: delay the probe service stop() by this many ms to observe the reload stop timeout.

spikeStartFailOnce.description: Spike 3 item 4: make the first probe service start() throw once to observe start-failure retry.
